selected_assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the canonical complete character and identity reference. Create a production 2D desktop-pet animation sprite sheet of THIS EXACT same cute white ferret (small round pink ears, white fluffy fur with pale blue shadows, huge glossy dark eyes, small black nose, two white feet, fluffy charcoal tail to viewer-right). Preserve the face proportions, linework, coloring and character identity rigorously. Transparent background. Sheet must have exactly SIX equal-sized cells in a 3 columns by 2 rows grid; no drawn grid or labels. All cells show the same complete full body character, same camera/front view, same scale and ground baseline, with generous transparent margins. Reading order is an animation of an enthusiastic friendly paw wave: 1 neutral relaxed front-facing standing with both forepaws hanging; 2 anticipation, head inclines slightly toward viewer-left, viewer-right forepaw elbow lifts to chest; 3 viewer-right forepaw raised beside cheek with rounded paw pads facing viewer and a warm small open smile, head tilts toward viewer-left; 4 the raised paw moves clearly outward in a friendly wave, elbow anatomically attached, head still tilted, eyes bright; 5 raised paw waves inward beside cheek, cheerful closed smiling eyelids, head still tilted; 6 forepaw lowers toward chest with a pleased expression, beginning return to neutral. The wave must have a clear 50% of head-height arm travel, not a tiny wiggle. The OTHER forepaw stays relaxed connected to chest. Feet stay planted on identical baseline. Each cell is one coherent complete illustration: no detached limbs, no cutouts, no scarf, no accessories, no props, no stickers, no shadows outside the character. Anatomically connected shoulders and natural short fluffy neck in EVERY pose. This is an animation asset, not a collage of different designs. No text, no watermark. Keep all six silhouettes fully inside their cells and separate.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Draw a clean 2D desktop-pet walk-cycle sprite sheet of the SAME cute fluffy white ferret character in the reference, with the same glossy big dark eyes, small pink round ears, tiny black nose, pale-blue fur shadows and fluffy charcoal tail. For WALKING the ferret gets down naturally onto ALL FOUR PAWS like a small animal. Do not draw a standing humanlike biped. Chibi full animal with a large cute head at viewer-RIGHT, a compact fluffy oval horizontal torso, four short rounded paws under the belly, fluffy dark tail flowing behind at viewer-LEFT. Facing right in side-three-quarter view, friendly smiling face; identical head camera view, facial proportions, head size, body size and tail silhouette in all cells. Exactly FOUR equally sized cells in 2 columns x 2 rows, reading order 1 2 3 4. Each full animal fully fits its own cell with generous margins. Four sequential frames of a seamless playful walking trot: 1 NEAR front paw reaches forward, NEAR rear paw back; 2 near front paw planted beneath shoulder, near rear paw swings forward lifted; 3 NEAR front paw reaches backward while FAR front paw clearly reaches forward, NEAR rear paw reaches forward; 4 near front paw lifted bent under chest while far front paw planted, near rear paw beneath hip. The near front paw MUST switch from forward in frame 1 to backward in frame 3. Show clear readable alternating paw positions under the belly, do not copy the same legs into every cell. Shoulder and hip proportions stay identical, body is anatomically connected and never broken up. Keep the SAME floor line and scale in every frame, tail gently trails. Same soft dark illustration outlines, softly shaded clean white fur. Genuine transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no captions, no lines, no props, no accessories, no watermark. No blue edge artifacts. Character should feel like a cute small animal walking, not a two-legged bear.
